message.reasoning_content:
We need to determine the crime(s) based on facts. The scenario: employee (business staff) uses his position to issue false delivery orders, uses company seal, takes goods out, sells low, uses proceeds to repay personal debt, rest wasted. The company got money back later. This is embezzlement? In Chinese criminal law, "职务侵占" (embezzlement by a person in a position of trust) is when a person in a position of authority (e.g., staff) misappropriates company property. The earlier example: 张某利用职务便利侵占律师事务所资金 -> "职务侵占". Here, Zhao used his position as a business staff to issue false delivery orders and take goods. That's similar to "职务侵占". Also could be "盗窃" (theft) but because he used his position and company seal, it's likely "职务侵占". The examples: "危险物品肇事" etc. So answer: [罪名]职务侵占<eoa>. Possibly also "挪用资金"? He used company goods, not cash. The crime of "挪用资金" is for misappropriation of funds. Here it's goods, so "职务侵占" is appropriate. Also maybe "诈骗"? No. So single crime.

Thus final answer: [罪名]职务侵占<eoa>
